objective: Convert heterogeneous Federation observations into provenance-bound canonical CFBE V4 experiment measurements without inventing scores, weakening proof gates or creating a second truth store.

composition.role: mission telemetry, mission value/cost/risk, owner intervention, mission efficiency and sequential evidence primitives
measurement constitution, progressive rollout cost/p95-latency ceilings, primary/secondary KPI definitions and hard non-regression vetoes
ExperimentOption economics and EvidenceEconomicsSelector for evidence-acquisition route ranking
eight-dimension observed numerator/denominator normalization and fail-closed promotion boundary
canonical raw measurement evidence plane; no parallel database
failure/recovery, truth-boundary, freshness/drift and independent assurance evidence inputs

algorithms.name: PROVENANCE_BOUND_OBSERVATION_COMPILER
algorithms.rule: Every normalized dimension requires one observed numerator plus one explicit target/ceiling denominator, each with evidence references. Benefit=observed/target; burden=observed/ceiling.

algorithms.name: EMPIRICAL_EVIDENCE_GRADIENT_PLANNER
algorithms.rule: Use greedy missing-dimension set cover; where routes cover equal new dimensions, reuse FC-OS EvidenceEconomicsSelector as the tie-break court. Never convert expected route economics into observed measurements.

algorithms.name: TEN_X_ROLLOUT_BOUND_ADAPTER
algorithms.rule: Reuse only semantically exact stage ceilings from SOVARA 10X rollout policy: maximum_cost_per_accepted_mission_usd -> estimated_cost and maximum_p95_latency_ms -> latency_burden. The policy evidence reference is mandatory and mission-level cost/elapsed-time fields are not treated as aliases.

truth_boundary: This capability creates a measurement compiler and evidence-acquisition plan, not measurements themselves. Real V4 readiness still requires receiver-specific empirical evidence, provenance, regression baselines and any independent/provider proof required by the existing gate.
